mapper.select: SELECT p.prj_id,p.cntrct_ty_cd,p.prj_stts_cd,p.use_yn FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id=#{id}
SELECT d.dev_id,d.emp_se_cd,d.use_yn FROM mst.dev d WHERE d.dev_id=#{id}
mapper.sql: SELECT a.asgn_id,a.asgn_no,a.prj_id,p.prj_nm,a.dev_id,d.dev_nm,d.mng_no,a.job_cd, a.bgn_dt,a.end_dt,COALESCE(a.plan_end_dt,a.end_dt) AS plan_end_dt,a.asgn_rt,a.asgn_se_cd, CASE WHEN p.cntrct_ty_cd IN ('TK','IN') THEN NULL ELSE a.untprc_base_cd END AS untprc_base_cd, a.ext_psblty_cd,a.cntrct_dev_id,c.dev_nm AS cntrct_dev_nm,a.asgn_stts_cd,a.rplc_asgn_id, CASE WHEN p.cntrct_ty_cd IN ('TK','IN') THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT r.bill_untprc_amt FROM asgn.untprc_hist r WHERE r.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND r.aply_bgn_dt <= #{today} ORDER BY r.aply_bgn_dt DESC LIMIT 1) END AS bill_untprc_amt, COALESCE((SELECT m.mm_qty FROM asgn.asgn_mth m WHERE m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=to_char(CAST(#{today} AS date),'YYYY-MM')),0) AS current_month_mm_qty, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(m.mm_qty) FROM asgn.asgn_mth m JOIN asgn.asgn x ON x.asgn_id=m.asgn_id WHERE x.dev_id=a.dev_id AND x.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND m.work_ym=to_char(CAST(#{today} AS date),'YYYY-MM')),0) AS person_month_mm_qty, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(m.mm_qty) FROM asgn.asgn_mth m WHERE m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND left(m.work_ym,4)=CAST(#{year} AS text)),0) AS year_mm_qty, COALESCE(a.updated_at,a.created_at) AS updated_at,a.rmrk_desc FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id LEFT JOIN mst.dev c ON c.dev_id=a.cntrct_dev_id
mapper.select: SELECT m.work_ym,COALESCE(m.auto_mm_qty,m.mm_qty) AS auto_mm_qty,m.mm_qty,m.mnl_yn, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(t.mm_qty) FROM asgn.asgn_mth t JOIN asgn.asgn x ON x.asgn_id=t.asgn_id WHERE x.dev_id=a.dev_id AND x.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND t.work_ym=m.work_ym),0) AS person_month_mm_qty, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_ym=m.work_ym AND c.cls_stts_cd='CLOSED') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS closed_yn FROM asgn.asgn_mth m JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.asgn_id=m.asgn_id WHERE m.asgn_id=#{id} ORDER BY m.work_ym
SELECT r.aply_bgn_dt,r.bill_untprc_amt FROM asgn.untprc_hist r WHERE r.asgn_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.aply_bgn_dt

SELECT h.*,c.cd_nm AS rsn_nm,t.aply_dt AS fix_trgt_aply_dt,t.asgn_chg_ty_cd AS fix_trgt_chg_ty_cd, CASE WHEN h.chg_user_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE u.user_nm END AS chg_user_nm FROM asgn.asgn_chg_hist h LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl c ON c.cd_grp_id='ASGN_CHG_RSN' AND c.dtl_cd=h.rsn_cd LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_chg_hist t ON t.asgn_chg_id=h.fix_trgt_chg_id LEFT JOIN sys.user_info u ON u.user_id=h.chg_user_id WHERE h.asgn_id=#{id} ORDER BY h.aply_dt DESC,h.chg_at DESC,h.asgn_chg_id DESC
SELECT c.cls_ym FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_stts_cd='CLOSED' ORDER BY c.cls_ym
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(m.mm_qty),0) FROM asgn.asgn_mth m JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.asgn_id=m.asgn_id WHERE a.dev_id=#{developer} AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND m.work_ym=#{month}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cmn.cd_dtl c JOIN cmn.cd_grp g ON g.cd_grp_id=c.cd_grp_id WHERE c.cd_grp_id=#{group} AND c.dtl_cd=#{code} AND c.use_yn='Y' AND g.use_yn='Y')
SELECT c.cd_nm FROM cmn.cd_dtl c WHERE c.cd_grp_id=#{group} AND c.dtl_cd=#{code}

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn_mth m JOIN fin.mth_cls c ON c.cls_ym=m.work_ym WHERE m.asgn_id=#{id} AND c.cls_stts_cd='CLOSED') THEN '마감된 월별 MM이 있습니다.' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bill.bill_dtl b WHERE b.asgn_id=#{id}) THEN '청구 상세 연결 이력이 있습니다.' END
SELECT count(*) FROM asgn.asgn_chg_hist h WHERE h.asgn_id=#{id} AND h.asgn_chg_ty_cd='EXTEND' AND h.fixed_yn='N'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM asgn.asgn_mth m WHERE m.asgn_id=#{id} AND m.work_ym>to_char(CAST(#{end} AS date),'YYYY-MM') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_ym=m.work_ym AND c.cls_stts_cd='CLOSED')
DELETE FROM asgn.asgn_mth m WHERE m.asgn_id=#{id} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_ym=m.work_ym AND c.cls_stts_cd='CLOSED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asgn.asgn_mth(asgn_id,work_ym,auto_mm_qty,mm_qty,mnl_yn) SELECT #{id},#{month},#{automatic},#{quantity},#{manual} WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_ym=#{month} AND c.cls_stts_cd='CLOSED') ON CONFLICT(asgn_id,work_ym) DO UPDATE SET auto_mm_qty=excluded.auto_mm_qty, mm_qty=CASE WHEN asgn_mth.mnl_yn='Y' THEN asgn_mth.mm_qty ELSE excluded.mm_qty END

INSERT INTO asgn.untprc_hist(asgn_id,aply_bgn_dt,bill_untprc_amt,created_by) VALUES(#{id},#{date},#{amount},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT(asgn_id,aply_bgn_dt) DO UPDATE SET bill_untprc_amt=excluded.bill_untprc_amt
